say:1:1322222001:1.text: To make the people of Whiteridge understand the Graveborn, we need to change their perception.
say:1:1322222001:1.source_cn: 想让白山的人们重新认识亡灵，需要改变他们的认知。

say:2:1322222002:1.text: If only there was something that could prove to the people that the undead were the warriors who protected this land thousands of years ago.
say:2:1322222002:1.source_cn: 如果有一些东西能够向人们证明活死人其实是当年的战士们就好了。

say:3:1322222003:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you head to Sorrowfall Lake and search for anything—anything at all—that belonged to the warriors? Even the smallest item could be proof that we need to clear their names.
